manice Erbstein) vel Hammitè maiorem. Secunda

page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so many lines end in fragments and are given as far as they show. Two woodcut figures (a round, netted object at top and a granular, knobbed object in the middle) are illustrations and not transcribed. The faint text at the centre and right is show-through from the other side of the leaf and is left out. "pres-Ben" ends with a printed hyphen, which I have kept. Left edge of the printed text is cut off; words are cut at the left, so some partial words are reconstructed from their visible endings and are uncertain. The figures are woodcuts and are not transcribed.
